Plain language

What is decision intelligence?

Decision intelligence is software that sits between your data and your decisions: it detects what changed, explains why, and recommends what to do next. Where a dashboard shows numbers and an assistant answers prompts, decision intelligence carries the question through to an approved, executed change.

Ridgeline Research, The Decision Intelligence Landscape, 2026 · fictional analyst, illustrative
